name: academic-research-suite
description: Rigorous literature synthesis, academic writing, review, methodology, citation, and revision workflows for economics, finance, and business research.

interface.shortDescription: Literature synthesis, research writing, and methodological review.
interface.longDescription: Eight focused workflows for reviewing literature and building research frameworks, developing Q1 and SSCI manuscripts, conducting strict peer review, writing research proposals, auditing panel econometrics, reviewing PLS-SEM and fsQCA, verifying citations, and managing reviewer responses.
defaultPrompt: Synthesize this literature and build a research framework.
Verify every citation and reference in this paper.
Assess this panel, PLS-SEM, or fsQCA analysis.
